title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 103 Center Street West in Eatonville, Washington, as the "National Park Ranger Margaret Anderson Post Office".
official_summary:
(This measure has not been amended since it was introduced. The summary of that version is repeated here.)

Designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 103 Center Street West in Eatonville, Washington, as the "National Park Ranger Margaret Anderson Post Office."

summary.headline: Names a Post Office building in Eatonville, Washington, after National Park Ranger Margaret Anderson.
summary.what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 103 Center Street West in Eatonville, Washington, as the "National Park Ranger Margaret Anderson Post Office." It changes only the official name of the building. It does not change postal services, mail delivery, staffing, or hours.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on June 9, 2014.
